title: 整园项目报价全过程
titleEn: Pricing a Whole-Kindergarten Project, Step by Step
desc: 从询盘到 20 万美金订单的完整英语流程——问什么、怎么报、怎么跟进。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Imagine a Dubai client emails: building a 12-classroom kindergarten. What is the first reply?
lines.cn: 想象一个迪拜客户发邮件：建 12 班幼儿园。第一封回复怎么写？

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Definitely not a price list. I ask: site area, age group, opening date, budget, CAD layout.
lines.cn: 肯定不是报价单。我问：场地面积、年龄段、开园日期、预算、CAD 图。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Once they send the CAD, our design team makes a 3D rendering. Two free revision rounds. Then final CAD and a detailed quote.
lines.cn: 他们发了 CAD，我们设计团队出 3D 效果图。两轮免费修改。然后出最终 CAD 和详细报价。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: FOB Ningbo. Split into classroom furniture, functional rooms, outdoor equipment, packing. Volume tiers — 500 sets vs 200 sets.
lines.cn: FOB 宁波。分班级家具、功能教室、户外设备、包装。数量阶梯——500 套和 200 套不同价。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Thirty percent T/T deposit, seventy against B/L copy. For 200k projects, L/C at sight is also fine.
lines.cn: 30% 电汇定金，70% 见提单副本。20 万以上项目也接受即期信用证。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Furniture 45 days, custom outdoor 60 to 90 days. Weekly photo updates. ETA tracking.
lines.cn: 家具 45 天，非标户外 60-90 天。每周照片更新。ETA 追踪。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Build trust, over-deliver on the proposal, then ask for the deposit. The project sells itself once the 3D looks right.
lines.cn: 建立信任，方案超出预期，然后要定金。3D 图好看，项目自己就成了。
